tools.name: thebusinessapp_get_account
tools.description: Show which company and which scopes the connected API key has. Use it first to check access. TheBusinessApp API: GET /me.

tools.name: thebusinessapp_list_customers
tools.description: List customers (people and businesses you work for), newest first. Filter by email or status. TheBusinessApp API: GET /customers.

tools.name: thebusinessapp_get_customer
tools.description: Get one customer by id, with name, contact details, tags and payment terms. TheBusinessApp API: GET /customers/{id}.

tools.name: thebusinessapp_list_contacts
tools.description: List the contact people on customer accounts (name, role, email, phone). Filter by customer. TheBusinessApp API: GET /contacts.

tools.name: thebusinessapp_list_sites
tools.description: List sites and properties (addresses where work happens), optionally for one customer. TheBusinessApp API: GET /sites.

tools.name: thebusinessapp_list_enquiries
tools.description: List enquiries (new leads in the pipeline), newest first. Filter by status or customer. TheBusinessApp API: GET /enquiries.

tools.name: thebusinessapp_get_enquiry
tools.description: Get one enquiry by id, with the customer's request and its pipeline details. TheBusinessApp API: GET /enquiries/{id}.

tools.name: thebusinessapp_list_quotes
tools.description: List quotes, newest first. Filter by status or customer. TheBusinessApp API: GET /quotes.

tools.name: thebusinessapp_get_quote
tools.description: Get one quote by id, with its line items and totals. TheBusinessApp API: GET /quotes/{id}.

tools.name: thebusinessapp_list_jobs
tools.description: List jobs (work orders), newest first. Filter by status, customer or assigned staff member. TheBusinessApp API: GET /jobs.

tools.name: thebusinessapp_get_job
tools.description: Get one job by id, with its status, schedule, value and access notes. TheBusinessApp API: GET /jobs/{id}.

tools.name: thebusinessapp_list_visits
tools.description: List visits (scheduled site trips for a job), newest first. Filter by job or status. TheBusinessApp API: GET /visits.

tools.name: thebusinessapp_list_invoices
tools.description: List invoices, newest first. Filter by status, customer or job. Shows drafts as well as sent invoices. TheBusinessApp API: GET /invoices.

tools.name: thebusinessapp_get_invoice
tools.description: Get one invoice by id, with its line items, totals and status. TheBusinessApp API: GET /invoices/{id}.

tools.name: thebusinessapp_list_payments
tools.description: List payments received against invoices (read only). TheBusinessApp API: GET /payments.

tools.name: thebusinessapp_list_products
tools.description: List the price list: services, labour, materials and equipment with unit prices. TheBusinessApp API: GET /products.

tools.name: thebusinessapp_list_staff
tools.description: List staff members with role and active flag. Pay rates are never returned. TheBusinessApp API: GET /staff.

tools.name: thebusinessapp_list_timesheets
tools.description: List logged time entries, optionally for one staff member, job or approval state (read only). TheBusinessApp API: GET /timesheets.

tools.name: thebusinessapp_list_stock_items
tools.description: List stock levels per product and location (read only). TheBusinessApp API: GET /stock-items.

tools.name: thebusinessapp_create_customer
tools.description: Create a customer. Writes a record only. TheBusinessApp API: POST /customers.

tools.name: thebusinessapp_update_customer
tools.description: Change the fields you send on one customer; other fields stay as they are. TheBusinessApp API: PATCH /customers/{id}.

tools.name: thebusinessapp_create_enquiry
tools.description: Add a new enquiry (lead) to the pipeline. Its source is set to api. TheBusinessApp API: POST /enquiries.

tools.name: thebusinessapp_create_quote
tools.description: Create a DRAFT quote for a customer. Totals are worked out for you. The quote is not sent; it stays in the app for a person to check and send. TheBusinessApp API: POST /quotes.

tools.name: thebusinessapp_create_job
tools.description: Create a job (work order) for a customer, optionally scheduled. TheBusinessApp API: POST /jobs.

tools.name: thebusinessapp_update_job
tools.description: Change the fields you send on one job, e.g. status to done. Other fields stay as they are. TheBusinessApp API: PATCH /jobs/{id}.

tools.name: thebusinessapp_add_job_visit
tools.description: Schedule a visit (a site trip) on a job. TheBusinessApp API: POST /jobs/{id}/visits.

tools.name: thebusinessapp_update_visit
tools.description: Change a visit's status, time or notes. TheBusinessApp API: PATCH /visits/{id}.

tools.name: thebusinessapp_create_invoice
tools.description: Create a DRAFT invoice for a customer. It is never sent and no payment is taken; a person sends it in the app. TheBusinessApp API: POST /invoices.

tools.name: thebusinessapp_create_product
tools.description: Add an item to the price list. TheBusinessApp API: POST /products.

tools.name: thebusinessapp_get_accounting_export
tools.description: Get one accounting export (sales, bills, contacts, bank, payments, products or credits) for Xero, QuickBooks, Sage 50, Sage Business Cloud or FreeAgent, as JSON with row counts. Needs the exports:read scope. TheBusinessApp API: GET /exports/{target}/{dataset}.

findings.title: Lethal trifecta: untrusted input + private data + external sink
findings.detail: Server "mcp" exposes tools that together enable an exfiltration flow. Untrusted content: thebusinessapp_list_customers, thebusinessapp_list_contacts, thebusinessapp_create_quote, thebusinessapp_create_product · Private data: thebusinessapp_get_account, thebusinessapp_get_customer, thebusinessapp_list_contacts, thebusinessapp_create_customer, thebusinessapp_get_accounting_export · Public sink: thebusinessapp_list_customers, thebusinessapp_list_contacts, thebusinessapp_create_customer, thebusinessapp_update_customer, thebusinessapp_create_enquiry, thebusinessapp_create_quote, thebusinessapp_create_job, thebusinessapp_update_job, thebusinessapp_add_job_visit, thebusinessapp_create_invoice, thebusinessapp_create_product.

evidence.snippet: Untrusted content: thebusinessapp_list_customers, thebusinessapp_list_contacts, thebusinessapp_create_quote, thebusinessapp_create_product · Private data: thebusinessapp_get_account, thebusinessapp_get_customer, thebusinessapp_list_contacts, thebusinessapp_create_customer, thebusinessapp_get_accounting_export · Public sink: thebusinessapp_list_customers, thebusinessapp_list_contacts, thebusinessapp_create_customer, thebusinessapp_update_customer, thebusinessapp_create_enquiry, thebusinessapp_create_quote, thebusinessapp_create_job, thebusinessapp_update_job, thebusinessapp_add_job_visit, thebusinessapp_create_invoice, thebusinessapp_create_product

findings.remediation: Do not co-install these capabilities under one trust boundary; an injected comment/email can steer the model to exfiltrate via the sink tool.
